item.title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos

turns.text: Make three square listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug: one on pure white, one on a cosy breakfast table, and one close-up of the rim and glaze. Same mug in all three, realistic photos, no text. Send them as separate images.

item.tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

answer_sheet.Product appearance: A plain sage-green ceramic mug; exact shape is your call, but keep it identical across all three images.
answer_sheet.Required views: A pure-white-background shot, a cosy breakfast-table lifestyle shot, and a close-up of the rim and glaze.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Realistic product photography, with a cosy mood for the lifestyle shot.
answer_sheet.Size and delivery: Three separate square images; 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.

turns.text: Could you make listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug, because I’m trying to get the product pictures sorted out? I always worry a little about whether product photos will feel like they belong together. What I need is three square images, with one showing the mug on pure white and another showing it on a cosy breakfast table. The third should be a close-up of the rim and glaze, and it needs to be the same mug in all three. Please make them realistic photos with no text, and send them as separate images.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.user: No, please don’t include any words, text, or branding on the mug or anywhere in the images. I’d like it to stay a plain sage-green ceramic mug, with the same shape across all three photos. Three separate square images at 640 × 640 would be fine.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the photos because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No images were created.

Once credits are available, I can make the three separate 640 × 640 photos—white background, cosy breakfast table, and rim/glaze close-up—using the first image as a reference to help keep the mug’s shape and colour consistent, with no text or branding.

style.prompt: One realistic studio product listing photograph, square 640 x 640 composition. A single plain sage-green ceramic mug on a pure white seamless background. Design to keep consistent for a product photo series: straight cylindrical body with gently rounded bottom corners, thick softly rounded rim, one simple rounded C-shaped handle on the right, uniform muted sage-green satin-gloss ceramic glaze inside and outside, subtle natural ceramic texture. Empty mug. Three-quarter eye-level view slightly from above, entire mug and handle visible, centered with generous white margin. Soft diffused daylight from upper left, accurate sage color, subtle soft contact shadow only, crisp photographic detail, realistic proportions and materials. No lettering, text, logos, branding, patterns, watermark, labels or other objects. A single photo, not a collage.
